mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (3523, -2184) and has to end up at (-255.6, -1314). On the way it must stop at A (North Forte) at (4111, -2302), B (Macro Shamrock) at (4122, -2246); visit A before B. Keep it no lower than 902.1 m and no higher than 1080.5 m. The whole trip may not be longer than 6160 meters. The battery only allows 11358 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery).
